answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the plume of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt. What survives to the ocean is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
